A slightly elevated SWR is the trade-off for a single wire antenna that covers multiple bands efficiently. They feature an exclusive serpentine wire-weave grip for insulated antenna wire. The DXE-MC20-C4-1 Balun features separate transformer and choke cores for the best all-band feedpoint isolation performance and has an downward facing SO-239 connector for your 50-ohm coaxial cable. specs.Product Line: Par EndFedz® Antennas

ov: Par EndFedz® End Fed Half Wave Antennas Par EndFedz® Antennas are low-power End Fed Half Wave (EFHW) antennas with the match box coax connection at the end of the wire, for convenient and quick stealth portable operations. These single-band and multi-band antennas can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or as a sloper. No ground plane or counterpoise is needed so portable operation could not be easier. Simply hang the far end from a tree limb or send the wire out hotel room window or balcony. You can use a telescoping fiberglass mast to get the antenna really high in the air and the supplied end insulators the installation easy. Stealth operation in CC&R and HOA antenna restricted locations is simplified. The mono-band models' all black construction makes them difficult to see. Each Par EndFedz® features a UV resistant ABS plastic housing with support rope attachment hole that encloses an efficient matching network to allow the antenna to be fed with standard 50 ohm coaxial cable with PL-259. All hardware is stainless steel and the SO-239 connector is silver plated with PTFE dielectric. The antenna wires are either 18 or 26 AWG stranded Copperweld® with 200 pound breaking strength and a tough, 100% UV stable black polyethylene jacket. One end of the antenna wire has a #10 solder lug making attachment to the matching network feedpoint simple and easily replaceable, if necessary. Standard single and multi-band versions handle 100 or 200 watts and high power versions handle 300 watts. Lightweight QRP PolyStealth models handle 25 watts and are ideal for portable operation because they are lightweight; the MKII model weighs only 8 ounces and the Trail Friendly model weighs only 3.5 oz. Par EndFedz® Antennas require no counterpoise or extra conductors.The manufacturer refers to these antennas as "End Fed Dipoles" based upon the assertion that a "half wave radiator is a dipole." This is a variant of the classic definition of a dipole that is center-fed antenna with two radiating legs running in opposite directions from the feedpoint. Additional claims about the EFHW state that end feeding a half wave "can energize the radiator nearly as well as a center-fed." EF-QUAD EndFedz® Antenna 40-20-15-10 meters

ov: Momobeam Multiband Coil Shortened End Fed Wire Antennas Momobeam Multiband End Fed Wire Antennas are the perfect HF solution for operators seeking simplicity, versatility, and performance. Designed for both fixed and portable operation, these multiband antennas can be deployed quickly in horizontal, inverted L, or sloper configurations—ideal for operators on the go. Covering the 80–10m amateur bands, they deliver reliable multiband performance.Built to last, these end-fed wire antennas feature stainless steel hardware and UV-resistant materials for long-term durability. ov: Par EndFedz® End Fed Half Wave Antennas Par EndFedz® Antennas are low-power End Fed Half Wave (EFHW) antennas with the match box coax connection at the end of the wire, for convenient and quick stealth portable operations. These single-band and multi-band antennas can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or as a sloper. No ground plane or counterpoise is needed so portable operation could not be easier. Simply hang the far end from a tree limb or send the wire out hotel room window or balcony. You can use a telescoping fiberglass mast to get the antenna really high in the air and the supplied end insulators the installation easy. Stealth operation in CC&R and HOA antenna restricted locations is simplified. The mono-band models' all black construction makes them difficult to see. Each Par EndFedz® features a UV resistant ABS plastic housing with support rope attachment hole that encloses an efficient matching network to allow the antenna to be fed with standard 50 ohm coaxial cable with PL-259. All hardware is stainless steel and the SO-239 connector is silver plated with PTFE dielectric. The antenna wires are either 18 or 26 AWG stranded Copperweld® with 200 pound breaking strength and a tough, 100% UV stable black polyethylene jacket. One end of the antenna wire has a #10 solder lug making attachment to the matching network feedpoint simple and easily replaceable, if necessary. Standard single and multi-band versions handle 100 or 200 watts and high power versions handle 300 watts. Lightweight QRP PolyStealth models handle 25 watts and are ideal for portable operation because they are lightweight; the MKII model weighs only 8 ounces and the Trail Friendly model weighs only 3.5 oz. Par EndFedz® Antennas require no counterpoise or extra conductors.The manufacturer refers to these antennas as "End Fed Dipoles" based upon the assertion that a "half wave radiator is a dipole." This is a variant of the classic definition of a dipole that is center-fed antenna with two radiating legs running in opposite directions from the feedpoint. Additional claims about the EFHW state that end feeding a half wave "can energize the radiator nearly as well as a center-fed." EF-QUAD EndFedz® Antenna 40-20-15-10 meters

ov: Momobeam Multiband Coil Shortened End Fed Wire Antennas Momobeam Multiband End Fed Wire Antennas are the perfect HF solution for operators seeking simplicity, versatility, and performance. Designed for both fixed and portable operation, these multiband antennas can be deployed quickly in horizontal, inverted L, or sloper configurations—ideal for operators on the go. Covering the 80–10m amateur bands, they deliver reliable multiband performance.Built to last, these end-fed wire antennas feature stainless steel hardware and UV-resistant materials for long-term durability. At their core is a coated copper wire radiator paired with a 49:1 impedance transformer, ensuring efficient 50-Ohm operation across the entire frequency range. The included coil provides the required inductance to load the antenna wires that are shorter than their normal length. Rooted in the rich history of end-fed technology—dating back to the Zepp antennas used on Zeppelin airships during World War I—these antennas combine proven design principles with modern engineering for unmatched versatility. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned operator, Momobeam Multiband End Fed Wire Antennas are your go-to solution for dependable HF performance.Key Features:- Quick & Flexible Installation: Easily deployable in horizontal, inverted L, or sloper configurations.- Wideband Coverage: On the 80–10M amateur bands for true multiband capability.- Durable Construction: Stainless Hardware and UV-resistant materials ensure long-lasting performance.Additional Features and Specifications: Band Coverage: 80-10 MetersPower Handling, 100W, 300W, or 1,000W (based on selected model)Antenna Type: Coil Shortened End Fed WireLoading Coil: Built-inImpedance Matching Transformer: 49:1 ratioAntenna Elements: Coated copper core wire Hardware: Stainless SteelMaterials: UV-resistant box and wire Installation Options: Horizontal, inverted L, sloper Ideal Use: Fixed and portable Amateur radio activities

Wire Antenna Band: 10 meters Kelemen Monoband Dipoles Kelemen Monoband Dipoles are high-quality, preassembled wire antennas featuring full-size models and a few shortened low-band models with coils for lengths that are easier to fit in the yard. Kelemen Dipoles are rugged; strong but lightweight, with good stability and excellent longevity. The included balun is intentionally not potted watertight to save on weight, instead using effective weep holes. Maximum power handling depends on each model's balun or coil used on shorter antennas. Kelemen Dipoles are pre-tuned to the lower end of the band (CW) because they are easily shortened for use on the phone (SSB) end of the band. Monoband dipoles are the simplest and most efficient type of dipole. Depending on the availability of supports, the Kelemen Dipole can be suspended in different ways and achieve different directional characteristics depending on the height. As an inverted-V set up close to the ground, it is an ideal omnidirectional antenna with strong high-angle radiation which is good for local traffic. The higher the dipole hangs, the flatter the radiation, and the better the chances for DX. Due to the light construction of the Kelemen dipoles, the requirements for the supports are not very high. For example, with inverted-vee setups, a push-up mast is usually sufficient as a mast. With horizontal suspension, a small tree with a pulley can often be used as a support point. Insulators and center hooks are included with each preassemble Kelemen Dipole antenna. For installation, use lengths of non-conductive antenna rope for the center support and for each end of the dipole. Order Kelemen Monoband Dipoles in North America exclusively from DX Engineering.

ov: Par EndFedz® End Fed Half Wave Antennas Par EndFedz® Antennas are low-power End Fed Half Wave (EFHW) antennas with the match box coax connection at the end of the wire, for convenient and quick stealth portable operations. These single-band and multi-band antennas can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or as a sloper. No ground plane or counterpoise is needed so portable operation could not be easier. Simply hang the far end from a tree limb or send the wire out hotel room window or balcony. You can use a telescoping fiberglass mast to get the antenna really high in the air and the supplied end insulators the installation easy. Stealth operation in CC&R and HOA antenna restricted locations is simplified. The mono-band models' all black construction makes them difficult to see. Each Par EndFedz® features a UV resistant ABS plastic housing with support rope attachment hole that encloses an efficient matching network to allow the antenna to be fed with standard 50 ohm coaxial cable with PL-259. All hardware is stainless steel and the SO-239 connector is silver plated with PTFE dielectric. The antenna wires are either 18 or 26 AWG stranded Copperweld® with 200 pound breaking strength and a tough, 100% UV stable black polyethylene jacket. One end of the antenna wire has a #10 solder lug making attachment to the matching network feedpoint simple and easily replaceable, if necessary. Standard single and multi-band versions handle 100 or 200 watts and high power versions handle 300 watts. Lightweight QRP PolyStealth models handle 25 watts and are ideal for portable operation because they are lightweight; the MKII model weighs only 8 ounces and the Trail Friendly model weighs only 3.5 oz. Par EndFedz® Antennas require no counterpoise or extra conductors.The manufacturer refers to these antennas as "End Fed Dipoles" based upon the assertion that a "half wave radiator is a dipole." This is a variant of the classic definition of a dipole that is center-fed antenna with two radiating legs running in opposite directions from the feedpoint. Additional claims about the EFHW state that end feeding a half wave "can energize the radiator nearly as well as a center-fed." EF-QUAD EndFedz® Antenna 40-20-15-10 meters

ov: Par EndFedz® End Fed Half Wave Antennas Par EndFedz® Antennas are low-power End Fed Half Wave (EFHW) antennas with the match box coax connection at the end of the wire, for convenient and quick stealth portable operations. These single-band and multi-band antennas can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or as a sloper. No ground plane or counterpoise is needed so portable operation could not be easier. Simply hang the far end from a tree limb or send the wire out hotel room window or balcony. You can use a telescoping fiberglass mast to get the antenna really high in the air and the supplied end insulators the installation easy. Stealth operation in CC&R and HOA antenna restricted locations is simplified. The mono-band models' all black construction makes them difficult to see. Each Par EndFedz® features a UV resistant ABS plastic housing with support rope attachment hole that encloses an efficient matching network to allow the antenna to be fed with standard 50 ohm coaxial cable with PL-259. All hardware is stainless steel and the SO-239 connector is silver plated with PTFE dielectric. The antenna wires are either 18 or 26 AWG stranded Copperweld® with 200 pound breaking strength and a tough, 100% UV stable black polyethylene jacket. One end of the antenna wire has a #10 solder lug making attachment to the matching network feedpoint simple and easily replaceable, if necessary. Standard single and multi-band versions handle 100 or 200 watts and high power versions handle 300 watts. Lightweight QRP PolyStealth models handle 25 watts and are ideal for portable operation because they are lightweight; the MKII model weighs only 8 ounces and the Trail Friendly model weighs only 3.5 oz. Par EndFedz® Antennas require no counterpoise or extra conductors.The manufacturer refers to these antennas as "End Fed Dipoles" based upon the assertion that a "half wave radiator is a dipole." This is a variant of the classic definition of a dipole that is center-fed antenna with two radiating legs running in opposite directions from the feedpoint. Additional claims about the EFHW state that end feeding a half wave "can energize the radiator nearly as well as a center-fed." EF-QUAD EndFedz® Antenna 40-20-15-10 meters

Alpha Delta HF SWL Sloper Antennas Alpha Delta HF SWL Sloper Antennas are a very unique and very effective adaptation of existing antenna theory. They operate as quarter wave slopers, which means that the wires are one quarter wavelength long; or multiples of a quarter-wave on each frequency band. These SWL Sloper Antennas are designed to cover: Medium Wave (0.5 to 1.6 MHz) and the 120, 90, 60, 49, 41, 31, 25, 21, 19, 16 and 13 meter SWL shortwave bands. Compared to a standard half wave dipole, the other quarter wave of these antennas, which is necessary for performance and the proper feed point impedance, is made up of the "Down-Lead" wire, which is attached. With a quarter wave sloper, the center conductor of the coax is attached to the radiating wires and the shield of the coax is attached to the down lead. Standard SO-239 (UHF female) connectors are provided on the ALP-DX-SWL for this purpose. Excellent performance is attained with installations of only 20 to 40 ft. in height. Historically, and by design, quarter wave sloper antennas are known to be excellent DX and long haul antennas. The current lobes, which define the major radiation characteristics of an antenna, are up high at the feed point and are not as subject to attenuation as a vertical antenna, whose current lobe is at ground level. At an Alpha Delta location, side by side comparisons between the ALP-DX-SWL and a 32 ft. commercial vertical with 18 radials show the DX-SWLs to be as much as 10 dB stronger into Europe and Africa. Since a sloper has an optimized low-angle radiation pattern for peak DX performance, it will greatly outperform a dipole mounted at the same height. ov: Par EndFedz® End Fed Half Wave Antennas Par EndFedz® Antennas are low-power End Fed Half Wave (EFHW) antennas with the match box coax connection at the end of the wire, for convenient and quick stealth portable operations. These single-band and multi-band antennas can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or as a sloper. No ground plane or counterpoise is needed so portable operation could not be easier. Simply hang the far end from a tree limb or send the wire out hotel room window or balcony. You can use a telescoping fiberglass mast to get the antenna really high in the air and the supplied end insulators the installation easy. Stealth operation in CC&R and HOA antenna restricted locations is simplified. The mono-band models' all black construction makes them difficult to see. Each Par EndFedz® features a UV resistant ABS plastic housing with support rope attachment hole that encloses an efficient matching network to allow the antenna to be fed with standard 50 ohm coaxial cable with PL-259. All hardware is stainless steel and the SO-239 connector is silver plated with PTFE dielectric. The antenna wires are either 18 or 26 AWG stranded Copperweld® with 200 pound breaking strength and a tough, 100% UV stable black polyethylene jacket. One end of the antenna wire has a #10 solder lug making attachment to the matching network feedpoint simple and easily replaceable, if necessary. Standard single and multi-band versions handle 100 or 200 watts and high power versions handle 300 watts. Lightweight QRP PolyStealth models handle 25 watts and are ideal for portable operation because they are lightweight; the MKII model weighs only 8 ounces and the Trail Friendly model weighs only 3.5 oz. Par EndFedz® Antennas require no counterpoise or extra conductors.The manufacturer refers to these antennas as "End Fed Dipoles" based upon the assertion that a "half wave radiator is a dipole." This is a variant of the classic definition of a dipole that is center-fed antenna with two radiating legs running in opposite directions from the feedpoint. Additional claims about the EFHW state that end feeding a half wave "can energize the radiator nearly as well as a center-fed." EF-QUAD EndFedz® Antenna 40-20-15-10 meters

Wire Antenna Band: 30 meters Kelemen Monoband Dipoles Kelemen Monoband Dipoles are high-quality, preassembled wire antennas featuring full-size models and a few shortened low-band models with coils for lengths that are easier to fit in the yard. Kelemen Dipoles are rugged; strong but lightweight, with good stability and excellent longevity. The included balun is intentionally not potted watertight to save on weight, instead using effective weep holes. Maximum power handling depends on each model's balun or coil used on shorter antennas. Kelemen Dipoles are pre-tuned to the lower end of the band (CW) because they are easily shortened for use on the phone (SSB) end of the band. Monoband dipoles are the simplest and most efficient type of dipole. Depending on the availability of supports, the Kelemen Dipole can be suspended in different ways and achieve different directional characteristics depending on the height. As an inverted-V set up close to the ground, it is an ideal omnidirectional antenna with strong high-angle radiation which is good for local traffic. The higher the dipole hangs, the flatter the radiation, and the better the chances for DX. Due to the light construction of the Kelemen dipoles, the requirements for the supports are not very high. For example, with inverted-vee setups, a push-up mast is usually sufficient as a mast. With horizontal suspension, a small tree with a pulley can often be used as a support point. Insulators and center hooks are included with each preassemble Kelemen Dipole antenna. For installation, use lengths of non-conductive antenna rope for the center support and for each end of the dipole. Order Kelemen Monoband Dipoles in North America exclusively from DX Engineering.

ov: Momobeam Multiband Coil Shortened End Fed Wire Antennas Momobeam Multiband End Fed Wire Antennas are the perfect HF solution for operators seeking simplicity, versatility, and performance. Designed for both fixed and portable operation, these multiband antennas can be deployed quickly in horizontal, inverted L, or sloper configurations—ideal for operators on the go. Covering the 80–10m amateur bands, they deliver reliable multiband performance.Built to last, these end-fed wire antennas feature stainless steel hardware and UV-resistant materials for long-term durability. Wire Antenna Band: 60 meters Kelemen Monoband Dipoles Kelemen Monoband Dipoles are high-quality, preassembled wire antennas featuring full-size models and a few shortened low-band models with coils for lengths that are easier to fit in the yard. Kelemen Dipoles are rugged; strong but lightweight, with good stability and excellent longevity. The included balun is intentionally not potted watertight to save on weight, instead using effective weep holes. Maximum power handling depends on each model's balun or coil used on shorter antennas. Kelemen Dipoles are pre-tuned to the lower end of the band (CW) because they are easily shortened for use on the phone (SSB) end of the band. Monoband dipoles are the simplest and most efficient type of dipole. Depending on the availability of supports, the Kelemen Dipole can be suspended in different ways and achieve different directional characteristics depending on the height. As an inverted-V set up close to the ground, it is an ideal omnidirectional antenna with strong high-angle radiation which is good for local traffic. The higher the dipole hangs, the flatter the radiation, and the better the chances for DX. Due to the light construction of the Kelemen dipoles, the requirements for the supports are not very high. For example, with inverted-vee setups, a push-up mast is usually sufficient as a mast. With horizontal suspension, a small tree with a pulley can often be used as a support point. Insulators and center hooks are included with each preassemble Kelemen Dipole antenna. specs.Product Line: Par EndFedz® Antennas

ov: Par EndFedz® End Fed Half Wave Antennas Par EndFedz® Antennas are low-power End Fed Half Wave (EFHW) antennas with the match box coax connection at the end of the wire, for convenient and quick stealth portable operations. These single-band and multi-band antennas can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or as a sloper. No ground plane or counterpoise is needed so portable operation could not be easier. Simply hang the far end from a tree limb or send the wire out hotel room window or balcony. You can use a telescoping fiberglass mast to get the antenna really high in the air and the supplied end insulators the installation easy. Stealth operation in CC&R and HOA antenna restricted locations is simplified. The mono-band models' all black construction makes them difficult to see. Each Par EndFedz® features a UV resistant ABS plastic housing with support rope attachment hole that encloses an efficient matching network to allow the antenna to be fed with standard 50 ohm coaxial cable with PL-259. All hardware is stainless steel and the SO-239 connector is silver plated with PTFE dielectric. The antenna wires are either 18 or 26 AWG stranded Copperweld® with 200 pound breaking strength and a tough, 100% UV stable black polyethylene jacket. One end of the antenna wire has a #10 solder lug making attachment to the matching network feedpoint simple and easily replaceable, if necessary. Standard single and multi-band versions handle 100 or 200 watts and high power versions handle 300 watts. Lightweight QRP PolyStealth models handle 25 watts and are ideal for portable operation because they are lightweight; the MKII model weighs only 8 ounces and the Trail Friendly model weighs only 3.5 oz. Par EndFedz® Antennas require no counterpoise or extra conductors.The manufacturer refers to these antennas as "End Fed Dipoles" based upon the assertion that a "half wave radiator is a dipole." This is a variant of the classic definition of a dipole that is center-fed antenna with two radiating legs running in opposite directions from the feedpoint. Additional claims about the EFHW state that end feeding a half wave "can energize the radiator nearly as well as a center-fed." EF-QUAD EndFedz® Antenna 40-20-15-10 meters

ov: Par EndFedz® End Fed Half Wave Antennas Par EndFedz® Antennas are low-power End Fed Half Wave (EFHW) antennas with the match box coax connection at the end of the wire, for convenient and quick stealth portable operations. These single-band and multi-band antennas can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or as a sloper. No ground plane or counterpoise is needed so portable operation could not be easier. Simply hang the far end from a tree limb or send the wire out hotel room window or balcony. You can use a telescoping fiberglass mast to get the antenna really high in the air and the supplied end insulators the installation easy. Stealth operation in CC&R and HOA antenna restricted locations is simplified. The mono-band models' all black construction makes them difficult to see. Each Par EndFedz® features a UV resistant ABS plastic housing with support rope attachment hole that encloses an efficient matching network to allow the antenna to be fed with standard 50 ohm coaxial cable with PL-259. All hardware is stainless steel and the SO-239 connector is silver plated with PTFE dielectric. The antenna wires are either 18 or 26 AWG stranded Copperweld® with 200 pound breaking strength and a tough, 100% UV stable black polyethylene jacket. One end of the antenna wire has a #10 solder lug making attachment to the matching network feedpoint simple and easily replaceable, if necessary. Standard single and multi-band versions handle 100 or 200 watts and high power versions handle 300 watts. Lightweight QRP PolyStealth models handle 25 watts and are ideal for portable operation because they are lightweight; the MKII model weighs only 8 ounces and the Trail Friendly model weighs only 3.5 oz. Par EndFedz® Antennas require no counterpoise or extra conductors.The manufacturer refers to these antennas as "End Fed Dipoles" based upon the assertion that a "half wave radiator is a dipole." This is a variant of the classic definition of a dipole that is center-fed antenna with two radiating legs running in opposite directions from the feedpoint. Additional claims about the EFHW state that end feeding a half wave "can energize the radiator nearly as well as a center-fed." EF-QUAD EndFedz® Antenna 40-20-15-10 meters

specs.Product Line: Par EndFedz® Antennas

ov: Par EndFedz® End Fed Half Wave Antennas Par EndFedz® Antennas are low-power End Fed Half Wave (EFHW) antennas with the match box coax connection at the end of the wire, for convenient and quick stealth portable operations. These single-band and multi-band antennas can be mounted horizontally, vertically, or as a sloper. No ground plane or counterpoise is needed so portable operation could not be easier. Simply hang the far end from a tree limb or send the wire out hotel room window or balcony. You can use a telescoping fiberglass mast to get the antenna really high in the air and the supplied end insulators the installation easy. Stealth operation in CC&R and HOA antenna restricted locations is simplified. The mono-band models' all black construction makes them difficult to see. Each Par EndFedz® features a UV resistant ABS plastic housing with support rope attachment hole that encloses an efficient matching network to allow the antenna to be fed with standard 50 ohm coaxial cable with PL-259. All hardware is stainless steel and the SO-239 connector is silver plated with PTFE dielectric. The antenna wires are either 18 or 26 AWG stranded Copperweld® with 200 pound breaking strength and a tough, 100% UV stable black polyethylene jacket. One end of the antenna wire has a #10 solder lug making attachment to the matching network feedpoint simple and easily replaceable, if necessary. Standard single and multi-band versions handle 100 or 200 watts and high power versions handle 300 watts. Lightweight QRP PolyStealth models handle 25 watts and are ideal for portable operation because they are lightweight; the MKII model weighs only 8 ounces and the Trail Friendly model weighs only 3.5 oz. Par EndFedz® Antennas require no counterpoise or extra conductors.The manufacturer refers to these antennas as "End Fed Dipoles" based upon the assertion that a "half wave radiator is a dipole." This is a variant of the classic definition of a dipole that is center-fed antenna with two radiating legs running in opposite directions from the feedpoint. Additional claims about the EFHW state that end feeding a half wave "can energize the radiator nearly as well as a center-fed." EF-QUAD EndFedz® Antenna 40-20-15-10 meters

ov: EAntenna HEX6B Six Band Hexbeam Antenna EAntenna HEX6B Six Band Hexbeam is a directional HF antenna for the six Amateur bands 20, 17, 15, 12, 10 and 6 meters. This design follows the ideas of Steve Hunt, G3TXQ, the originator of the Broadband version of the Hex Beam antenna. Refined by EAntenna the mechanical construction of this version uses their long-standing antenna engineering experience. The result is an efficient, lightweight portable antenna for the high HF DX bands which assembles quickly, making it ideal for DXpeditions and vacations. Installation at 20 ft. above the ground works quite well. A tower-mounted Hexbeam at a height of 35 to 60 ft. achieves maximum performance for excellent DX results.The HEX6B works as two element beam on each band. Ready-to-use wires and ropes are fixed to the fiberglass struts, so no tuning is required! Due to the mechanical tension of the struts, the beam is stretched to its fixed size all the time, so there is no sag on the wires. The radiator dipoles are connected to the vertical center support, with each band wire element attaching with screw clamps. The center support is designed as a coaxial transformer and balun, providing a particularly good match on each band, with one feedline for all six bands. The HEX6B forward gain is approximately 3dBD or better, the front/back ratio is between 13 and 22dB. SWR is 1.5:1 or better on all bands except 10m, where SWR is 2:1 or better. Each band can be used in full bandwidth without a tuner. The maximum allowed power is 5 kW. The fiberglass tubes are double coated against UV radiation.The setup of the HEX6B six band beam is simple and can be done by one person in about 30 minutes. Installation begins by assembling the 6 fiberglass struts to the center pole. Ready-cut ropes from the top of the center pole to each strut are installed for the typical upside-down umbrella shape of the hex beam. Then the ready-cut wires are attached to the struts and electrically connected to the center pole. All ropes and wires are already cut to length, so no tuning is required. Due to the low weight of only 18.7 lbs. (8.2 kg) this hex beam can be installed on a light aluminum push-up mast. Rotation is either done with a small rotator or by hand. The HEX6B mast clamp accommodates support poles with a 1.10 -2.05 in. (28-52mm) diameter.EAntenna HEX6B Hexbeam Specifications Bands: 20, 17

Bushcomm Horizon 6.7 Compact Non-Resonant Dipoles Bushcomm Horizon 6.7 Compact Non-Resonant Dipoles are compact all aluminum self-supported dipole antennas specifically designed for "Limited-Small space" applications. The 2850MOX is a horizontally polarized directional antenna that offers high gain for its very compact dimensions. This antenna features an additional third element for especially good gain on the 6 meter band. Ideal for the restricted property and for temporary or portable operations, this antenna can fit well on an existing mast where space is limited. Join the fun of weak-signal operations, locally, regionally or long range via Sporadic-E for DXing or contesting on the 10 and 6 meter bands. The 2850MOX offers high performance with very reasonable dimensions at a low cost.

ov: InnovAntenna DXC-140 40 Meter Rotatable Dipole InnovAntennas DXC-140 40 Meter Rotatable Dipole covers the entire 40 meter band with particularly good efficiency and impressive SWR bandwidth with a very reasonable wingspan, just over 39 feet (12m). InnovAntennas DXC-140 Compact 40 Meter Rotatable Dipole There are several methods to shorten a mast-mounted rotatable dipole, including loading coils and capacity hats. The position of the coils is critical to efficiency - closer to center is mechanically easier, further out is electrically better. The designer has used both methods to build the DXC-140 antenna robustly and efficiently, limiting the size to a turning radius under 20 ft. (6 m) that many radio amateurs can easily mount on their tower mast and rotate within their property limits.The advantage of this design is a very large usable bandwidth of the antenna - the DXC-140 can be used over the entire internationally approved range from 7.0 to 7.3 MHz without having to use a tuner (SWR 2:1 or better). In the DXing range from 7.0 to 7.2 MHz, the SWR is usually equal to or better than 1.6:1, making the efficiency of the antenna 89%!Due to the robust construction of the DXC-140, no guy wires are necessary. Some of the images of this model installed show examples with guy wires, as chosen by individual user dependent upon the location, due to the expectation of snow and ice, for example. However, the mechanical design and construction will handle heavy loads, with the element diameter of 2.17 in. (55mm) in the center with a wall thickness of 0.078 in. (2mm). The element diameter decreases towards the end of the element save weight, but the ends still have a diameter of 0.98 in. (25mm) to easily support the capacity hats.All in all, the DXC-140 40 Meter antenna combines a carefully calculated design with a very robust construction from an experienced antenna designer. This is also supported by the materials used: UV-resistant insulators, seawater-proof stainless steel hardware and aircraft grade aluminum elements. The result is a rotatable dipole with high efficiency, with an overall length of only 39.4 ft. (12m) and a weight of only 18.7 lbs. (8.5 kg).

InnovAntennas DXC-240 2 Element 40 Meter Yagi There are several methods to shorten a dipole or the elements of a beam, including loading coils and capacity hats. However, coils reduce efficiency if they are mounted too close to the boom of the Yagi and capacity hats can reduce the length by only a few percent. Through careful calculation and robust construction, InnovAntennas designer Justin Johnson, G0KSC, has managed to craft this two-element beam for 40 the meter band with a boom that is just under 23 ft. (7m) in length. The elements have a maximum length of 37.73 ft. (11.5m) and this beam achieves a 2:1 SWR bandwidth of 120 kHz without the use of an antenna tuner.The DXC-240 is a rugged, seriously heavy-duty 40 meter Yagi featuring a 2.362 in. (60mm) square boom with a wall thickness of 0.079 (2mm), making it very stable, even without truss ropes. The elements use 1.97 in. (50mm) diameter aluminum tubes in the middle, which quickly taper to 0.98 in (25mm) at the ends. The DXC-240 has a wind area of 13.5 sq. ft. (1.25 sq. m), weighs 110 lbs. (50 kg) and has a turning radius of 22.1 ft. (6.73m). Solidly constructed, efficient loading coils are at the middle of each half element, exactly where they belong to minimize losses and maximize bandwidth! Additional efficient reduction of length is achieved with capacity hats at the ends of the elements.The result is a compact 2-Element Yagi for 40m that can achieve gain of about 10.53 dBi at 65.6 ft. (20m) above ground with a spec of 6.29 dBi free space gain and a typical front to back of 15 dB. Impedance matching with an adjustable hairpin that provides a 50 ohm feedpoint that does not negatively affect the usable bandwidth.Order the InnovAntennas DXC-240 2-Element Compact 40 Meter Yagi from DX Engineering. ov: Chameleon Antenna Hybrid Mini BNC Portable HF Antennas Chameleon Antenna Hybrid Mini BNC Portable HF Antenna systems are offered with different wire lengths, allowing for the setup of a broadband long-wire antenna without additional parts. Simply choose the variation that fits your needs. Additional wire lengths and accessories are available, making it ideal for experimenting, or optimizing your antenna setup.The Hybrid Mini antenna base is a versatile system designed for the 160-6m bands, featuring a built-in 1:5 broadband matching transformer and a maximum power rating of 500W SSB, 100W CW, and 40W for high duty cycle digital modes. A 3/8-24in. threaded connector is included for mounting various antenna radiators, and a BNC female connector on the side for coaxial connection. The wire can be hung in various shapes, such as a sloper, inverted "V", inverted "L", or zigzag.Portable Antenna: The Hybrid Mini Base can be used with most any 3/8-24 in. mobile whip, extensions, and wires to create a wide variety of portable antennas. Vertical Antenna: Ideal for limited spaces, the Hybrid Mini base can be combined with the Chameleon MIL Whip to create a vertical antenna for the 160m - 6m bands, with a total length of only 9.8ft. (3m).Dipole Antenna: The base is also suitable for connecting various dipole antennas. Connect one leg of the dipole to the 'hot end' of the Hybrid-Mini base and the other to the ground connection. Depending on the installation height and type, you can achieve either a steep radiation pattern or the typical dipole characteristic.CHA-HYBRDMINI60B(1) Hybrid Mini Matching Unit, with BNC Connector(60 ft.) ov: REZ Antenna Systems Recon 40 Version 2 HF Portable Antenna Systems include a complete, high-quality fast deploy portable antenna system that is easily tuned for 40 through 10 meter operation. Perfect for portable operations such as POTA and SOTA activations, this system includes a best-in-class Recon 40 Version2 base-load tuning coil and a heavy-duty 17-foot (23.2-inch. collapsed) stainless-steel telescoping whip. Also included is a premium water-resistant MOLLE backpack, available in five colors. These rugged backpacks, also available separately, have plenty of space for the Ranger 40 precision-made antenna components as well as your 100W rig, mic, key, coax, battery and laptop.The heart of the REZ Antenna Systems Recon 40 Version 2 is the super rugged base-loaded adjustable tuning coil that is 'hands down' the best on the market. Made with CNC machined parts from premium materials, the Delrin body, black anodized 6061 aluminum base and top with all stainless steel hardware make the Recon 40 v.2 ready to take on any environment, any time. Made with 14GA enameled copper wire, the Recon 40 v.2 is rated for use at up to 500W SSB, 300W CW, and 200W digital (50% duty cycle). The coil’s machined wire groove provides mechanical support and optimal spacing to ensure a low loss coil. Switching bands is made easy with the integrated weatherproof coil bypass switch. When you’re ready to move to the higher bands simply flip the switch and tune the telescoping whip to your desired frequency.Along with its handy SO-239 connector, a standout feature of the new and improved Version 2 Recon 40 (REC40-II) is the integration of radial ports milled directly into the base of the antenna—eliminating the need for a separate radial puck. In the original model, users had to attach an external puck accessory to connect radials. Version 2 streamlines this process by building the functionality into the coil itself, enhancing both setup speed and field reliability. The integrated puck is precision-machined and supports up to eight 4mm banana plugs, allowing quick connection of REZ’s 4-wire radial kit and easy expansion of your radial field for improved ground performance and signal efficiency. Four included quick-deploy 33-foot 18 gauge radials are quickly connected with 4mm banana plugs. Additional radial sets are available separately. Base and whip connections are standard

ov: DX Commander CLASSIC 2 Plus 80m HF Multi-Band Vertical Antennas DX Commander CLASSIC 2 Plus 80m HF Multi-Band Vertical Antennas are an excellent choice for DX performance and general operations. Efficiently resonant on every HF band of operation, featuring wide SWR bandwidth and low take-off angle, the CLASSIC 2 Plus 80m covers the Amateur bands 80 to 2 meters* with the exception of 30M, as the 30M element is replaced with an 80M element.*. DX Commander vertical antennas are based on the same principles as a fan dipole, with several vertical wire elements of various resonant lengths connected to a common feedpoint. The wire elements and support ropes are arranged with spacer plates around the non-conductive fiberglass mast. When installed with an appropriate radial system, the CLASSIC 2 Plus 80m achieves efficient quarter-wave vertical performance with natural resonance and low SWR on every band, without the need for traps, coils or antenna tuners. Band-hopping DXing and simultaneous multi-band multiplexed operations are supported. The CLASSIC 2 Plus 80m antenna is rated at 1500W SSB/CW, 400W FT8 and other digital modes.The DX Commander CLASSIC 2 Plus 80m is one of the most economical, easy to build multi-band antenna systems. ov: DX Commander Rapide2 HF Multi-Band Vertical Antennas DX Commander Rapide2 HF Multi-Band Vertical Antennas feature a newly designed Metal End Cap Housing and Lock Ring, with a Rubber Insert, and an upgraded ground plate assembly. These resonant multi-band vertical antenna systems are designed to operate on the 30 through 10 meter Amateur Radio bands (with the 6m band handled by the 30m element as a 1.25 wavelength element). Operation on the 40 meter band is possible with the addition of a user made coil (see the user guide for details). DX Commander Rapide2 vertical antennas are based on the same principles as a fan dipole, with several vertical wire elements of various resonant lengths connected to a common feedpoint. Spacer Plates keep the wire elements and support ropes neatly arranged around the non-conductive fiberglass mast. When installed with an appropriate radial system, the Rapide2 achieves efficient quarter-wave vertical performance with natural resonance and low SWR on every band, with no traps, coils or antenna tuners. Band-hopping, DXing and simultaneous multi-band operations are supported. The Rapide2 antenna is rated at 1500W SSB/CW, 375W FT8 and other digital modes.The Rapide2 vertical antenna kit includes a 23 ft. (7m) (length approx.) telescoping mast, 328 ft. of DX10 wire where 82 ft. is for the wire antenna elements, and up to 246 ft. is leftover for use as radials. The Rapide2 includes 6 ground connection points on the ground plate. To achieve maximum efficiency, cut and install 24 10 ft. radials to make 4 wavelengths of radials for 20M on the ground. Crimping or soldering 4 radials per connector will allow quick antenna deployment in the field. The DX Commander Rapide2 antenna system is simple to build, lightweight and is ideal as a first antenna or for those with HOA restrictions. ov: InnovAntennas VertiGO HF Vertical Antenna 33V InnovAntennas VertiGO HF Vertical Antenna 33V is intended for the 40 through 15 meter bands (7 - 21.5 MHz) with a base-mounted remote tuner for DX and domestic operation. It stands at 33 ft. (10m) tall, which makes it the smallest and most inconspicuous of the three versions. The aluminum tubing diameters range from 1.97 in. (50mm) at the bottom to 0.51 in. (13mm) at the top, with nine sections. When fed directly, the 33V element is resonant at 40 and 15m. The antenna can be set up freestanding, without rope guying. Operation is possible on the 12, 10 and 6m bands, but is not intended for DX due to the high-angle pattern. The 33V can be a very good antenna for 40 through 15 meters when installed with a good radial system.InnovAntennas VertiGO HF Vertical Antennas cover multiple bands when fed as a non-resonant radiator using a remote antenna tuner mounted at the base. They can also be fed directly as a monoband vertical and are typically and most easily installed as a ground-mounted vertical, depending on the location and the support. To achieve the matching required by modern transceivers and amplifiers, other shortened vertical radiators use traps or coils but, those components contribute to losses and power lost as heat. InnovAntennas VertiGO Antennas radiate on all bands along their entire length. Radials are required for efficient operation of any HF vertical; 16 or more ground radials are better, where their length isn’t critical. A remote tuner installed at the base of the antenna provides maximum efficiency and the best performance on the bands indicated. Higher frequencies will tune but higher angle patterns will limit performance. A ferrite bead choke (DXE-FBC) should be used at the remote tuner on the coaxial cable from the station to prevent it from radiating and collecting RF noise. VertiGO Vertical Antennas from InnovAntennas are available in three different height versions, each with rugged aluminum tubing sections, swaged and slit at the top for the element clamps. Brackets, clamps and stainless steel hardware are included for mounting to a user supplied support pipe.InnovAntennas VertiGO HF Vertical Antennas:33V 40-15M 33 ft. version part number is IVA-18484-012243V 60-17M 43 ft. version part number is IVA-18484-012366V 80-17M 66 ft. version part number is IVA-18484-0124

ov: InnovAntennas FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas represent exciting developments for the fascinating hobby of long distance (DX) reception of free, over-the-air broadcast FM radio. The OP-DES Yagi directional antennas are specially designed for better gain, great front-to-back and patterns with fewer side lobes, to dramatically improve your reception experience by helping your tuner or receiver achieve a new level of performance. For FM DX enthusiasts who own great FM Tuners and Receivers, pulling in new distant stations at full quieting is thrilling. Capturing a weak station while rejecting an on-channel stronger station can be especially gratifying. Hearing distant fringe and local stations at full fidelity without noise is the ultimate goal for FM audiophiles as well as FM DXers. Even HD Radio enthusiasts can increase their channel count with full sound quality and fewer dropouts. One of the distinctive design features of the InnovAntennas OP-DES Yagis is a low feedpoint impedance that allows either 50 ohm or 75 ohm coaxial cable to be connected directly to the driven element, eliminating the losses of a transformer balun. With several boom lengths available, for the FM enthusiast on a budget, for the casual listener with a treasured vintage receiver, and for the most discerning FM Tuner audiophile, best-ever reception is possible with an InnovAntenna FM Broadcast OP-DES Yagi. What is so special about InnovAntenna FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas? The acronym stands for “Opposing Phase Driven Element System” on which the ends of the driven element are angled backwards towards the reflector, parallel to the boom. Opposing phase in the ends of the driven element achieves an exceptionally clean directional pattern with much better side rejection than other designs. Plus, the OP-DES Yagi retains incredibly good front-to-back while optimizing gain over a wide frequency range, essential for 88 to 108 MHz coverage. The special OP-DES Yagi design achieves a low feed point impedance that allows direct connection of either 50 or 75 ohm coaxial cable, so the mounting complexity and signal loss of a transformer balun is eliminated. The use of an optional ferrite bead RF choke on the coax at the feedpoint terminals is highly recommended. These OP-DES FM Broadcast antennas actually handle up to 3 kW FM power with low SWR. ov: Ciro Mazzoni MIDI Automatic Magnetic Loop Antennas Bring exciting new capabilities to limited space operations with unparalleled reliability and dramatically higher power handling. These are simply the best small transmitting loops available in the world!Ciro Mazzoni MIDI Automatic Magnetic Loop Antennas are made of tough, attractive, aircraft-grade aluminum. For hams suffering with HOA or deed restrictions, an efficient and comparatively small antenna can make a HUGE difference! In spite of their relatively compact size, these antennas are resonant over a wide range of bands; from 80 through 20 meters and continuously, without any frequency gaps. They're great for MARS and CAP use!Loop tubing is welded so no screw connections are present; thereby adding strength while completely eliminating intermittent connections and contact resistance. Their tuning capacitor is not a simple variable capacitor but a large, interleaved, air-variable capacitor made of hefty aluminum plates. Each set of capacitor plates is welded directly to opposite portions of the top of the loop. This method creates an extremely robust and stable capacitor!A weather-resistant actuator motor changes the loop diameter, causing it to expand or contract and thus adjusts the capacitor for minimum SWR. Resonance is adjusted by a control unit in the shack. Although resonant bandwidth is very small (as with all compact loops) tuning is very smooth and easily accomplished when you change bands or QSY within the band.The MZZ-MIDI-A includes an updated ATU 2.0 loop controller that features a black background display with Amber characters. The controller allows RS-232 direct-frequency control by certain radios. In rigs with CAT or CI-V output, antenna tuning will automatically track your VFO and band changes. The frequency information is directly transferred from the radio (Elecraft, ICOM, Kenwood, and Yaesu) to the controller, and then the antenna tunes automatically to the current frequency. To interface an ICOM transceiver, the optional Interface Cable is required to connect the Loop Antenna ATU 2.0 to Icom transceiver CI-V "Remote" connector. ov: Firestik Antenna Company 2M-4 5/8 Wave 2M Mobile Antennas Firestik Antenna Company 2M-4 5/8 Wave 2M Mobile Antennas are an omni-directional antenna designed for the 144 to 148 MHz, 2-meter amateur band. They offer the lowest angle of radiation of any mobile VHF antenna, making them a well-kept secret among knowledgeable users. These 5/8 wave (both physical and electrical) antennas have a nominal impedance of 50-52 ohms and can achieve an average tuned SWR of 1.5:1 over 4 MHz. The overall length is 48.2 inches (122.4 cm) and provide a gain of 6 dB over isotropic antenna and 3 dB over a 1/4 wave antenna. These 2M mobile antennas are rated at 400 watts AM and 800 PEPIn addition to their wide bandwidth and low angle of radiation, these antennas are resistant to static noise and can be tuned to higher frequencies. Test bench results show that the frequency increases by 300 KHz for every 0.125 inches of fiberglass/wire removed from the antenna.Their core is made of 3/8 in. (0.375 in. or 10 mm) solid fiberglass, using a special Firestik formula for a balance of ruggedness and flexibility. The conductor consists of double-insulated 19-gauge copper wire. The covering is high-quality PVC with added UV and pigment stabilizers. The antenna base is chrome-plated machined brass with standard 3/8-24 in. threads, ensuring full compatibility with all wide range of mounts and accessories.These are ground-plane dependent antennas, requiring a metallic counterpoise to perform properly. They are not suitable for use on non-metallic (composite) vehicles or those with insufficient metal. However, they can be used to build a base station antenna if a ground-plane is provided. When used with a transmitter (as opposed to a receiver), these antennas should be tested and tuned across the transceivers operating frequency. Using an untested, untuned antenna for transmitting can damage the transmitter's circuitry. Important: Ground-plane dependent antennas require mounting brackets and antenna stud mounts that are grounded to a chassis ground point. Powder coating, paint, and/or anodized surfaces are insulating coatings and must be removed down to the metal surface wherever a grounding point is required.Specifications: Frequency Range: 144 - 148 MHzPower Rating: 400 watts AM, 800 PEPWavelength: 5/8Gain: 6 dBi Height: 48.2 in.3/8-24 in. ov: InnovAntennas FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas represent exciting developments for the fascinating hobby of long distance (DX) reception of free, over-the-air broadcast FM radio. The OP-DES Yagi directional antennas are specially designed for better gain, great front-to-back and patterns with fewer side lobes, to dramatically improve your reception experience by helping your tuner or receiver achieve a new level of performance. For FM DX enthusiasts who own great FM Tuners and Receivers, pulling in new distant stations at full quieting is thrilling. Capturing a weak station while rejecting an on-channel stronger station can be especially gratifying. Hearing distant fringe and local stations at full fidelity without noise is the ultimate goal for FM audiophiles as well as FM DXers. Even HD Radio enthusiasts can increase their channel count with full sound quality and fewer dropouts. One of the distinctive design features of the InnovAntennas OP-DES Yagis is a low feedpoint impedance that allows either 50 ohm or 75 ohm coaxial cable to be connected directly to the driven element, eliminating the losses of a transformer balun. With several boom lengths available, for the FM enthusiast on a budget, for the casual listener with a treasured vintage receiver, and for the most discerning FM Tuner audiophile, best-ever reception is possible with an InnovAntenna FM Broadcast OP-DES Yagi. What is so special about InnovAntenna FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas? The acronym stands for “Opposing Phase Driven Element System” on which the ends of the driven element are angled backwards towards the reflector, parallel to the boom. Opposing phase in the ends of the driven element achieves an exceptionally clean directional pattern with much better side rejection than other designs. Plus, the OP-DES Yagi retains incredibly good front-to-back while optimizing gain over a wide frequency range, essential for 88 to 108 MHz coverage. The special OP-DES Yagi design achieves a low feed point impedance that allows direct connection of either 50 or 75 ohm coaxial cable, so the mounting complexity and signal loss of a transformer balun is eliminated. The use of an optional ferrite bead RF choke on the coax at the feedpoint terminals is highly recommended. These OP-DES FM Broadcast antennas actually handle up to 3 kW FM power with low SWR. VHF/UHF Beam Antenna Bands: 6 meters VHF/UHF Beam Antenna Elements (application): 6 Antenna Gain: 11.1 dBi Beam Antenna F/B (dB): 32.9 dB E-Plane 3 dB Beamwidth: 65° H-Plane 3 dB Beamwidth: 50° Bandwidth at 2:1 SWR: Over 600 kHz Typical Beam Polarization: Horizontal Beam Antenna Boom Wavelength: 0.81 InnovAntennas OP-DES 50 MHz Yagi Antennas InnovAntennas OP-DES 50 MHz Yagi Antennas are a relatively new development from InnovAntennas. OP-DES stands for Opposing Phase Driven Element System, in which the ends of the dipole radiator of these antennas is angled backwards towards the reflector, parallel to the boom. This results in opposing phase relationships in the ends of the driven element, providing a very clean directional pattern with few side lobes. The OP-DES Yagi has optimized gain over a wide frequency range, while retaining a good front-to-back ratio. The driven element dipole of an OP-DES antenna has a low impedance of 50 ohms. This eliminates the need for matching elements or a transformer balun. For this reason, the antenna is offered without a balun, but an RF choke balun made of ferrites on coax should be used at the feedpoint terminal studs. With the coaxial cable directly connected to the driven element dipole, well over full legal limit power levels are possible. Like all InnovAntennas Yagis, the OP-DES 50MHz antennas are extremely robustly constructed; the larger model uses truss cables for the boom. All elements of the antenna use high quality aluminum, the clamps and screws are made of stainless steel. The supplied mast clamp is designed for masts up to 2 in. (50mm) diameter. OP-DES stands for Opposing Phase Driven Element System, in which the ends of the dipole radiator of these antennas is angled backwards towards the reflector, parallel to the boom. This results in opposing phase relationships in the ends of the driven element, providing a very clean directional pattern with few side lobes. The OP-DES Yagi has optimized gain over a wide frequency range, while retaining a good front-to-back ratio. The driven element dipole of an OP-DES antenna has a low impedance of 50 ohms. This eliminates the need for matching elements or a transformer balun. For this reason, the antenna is offered without a balun, but an RF choke balun made of ferrites on coax should be used at the feedpoint terminal studs. With the coaxial cable directly connected to the driven element dipole, well over full legal limit power levels are possible. Like all InnovAntennas Yagis, the OP-DES 50MHz antennas are extremely robustly constructed; the larger model uses truss cables for the boom. All elements of the antenna use high quality aluminum, the clamps and screws are made of stainless steel. The supplied mast clamp is designed for masts up to 2 in. (50mm) diameter. ov: InnovAntennas FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas represent exciting developments for the fascinating hobby of long distance (DX) reception of free, over-the-air broadcast FM radio. The OP-DES Yagi directional antennas are specially designed for better gain, great front-to-back and patterns with fewer side lobes, to dramatically improve your reception experience by helping your tuner or receiver achieve a new level of performance. For FM DX enthusiasts who own great FM Tuners and Receivers, pulling in new distant stations at full quieting is thrilling. Capturing a weak station while rejecting an on-channel stronger station can be especially gratifying. Hearing distant fringe and local stations at full fidelity without noise is the ultimate goal for FM audiophiles as well as FM DXers. Even HD Radio enthusiasts can increase their channel count with full sound quality and fewer dropouts. One of the distinctive design features of the InnovAntennas OP-DES Yagis is a low feedpoint impedance that allows either 50 ohm or 75 ohm coaxial cable to be connected directly to the driven element, eliminating the losses of a transformer balun. With several boom lengths available, for the FM enthusiast on a budget, for the casual listener with a treasured vintage receiver, and for the most discerning FM Tuner audiophile, best-ever reception is possible with an InnovAntenna FM Broadcast OP-DES Yagi. What is so special about InnovAntenna FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas? The acronym stands for “Opposing Phase Driven Element System” on which the ends of the driven element are angled backwards towards the reflector, parallel to the boom. Opposing phase in the ends of the driven element achieves an exceptionally clean directional pattern with much better side rejection than other designs. Plus, the OP-DES Yagi retains incredibly good front-to-back while optimizing gain over a wide frequency range, essential for 88 to 108 MHz coverage. The special OP-DES Yagi design achieves a low feed point impedance that allows direct connection of either 50 or 75 ohm coaxial cable, so the mounting complexity and signal loss of a transformer balun is eliminated. The use of an optional ferrite bead RF choke on the coax at the feedpoint terminals is highly recommended. These OP-DES FM Broadcast antennas actually handle up to 3 kW FM power with low SWR. ov: InnovAntennas 162 MHz AIS LFA Yagis InnovAntennas 162 MHz AIS LFA Yagis are vertically polarized Loop Fed Array (LFA) base station beam antennas designed specifically for 161.5 – 162.5 MHz range of the Marine Band, featuring simplified installation with integral rear-mount mast brackets. Three models are offered, each performance optimized with extensive computer modeling. High quality materials are used in manufacturing, ensuring durability and high reliability. InnovAntennas LFA Yagis inherently receive less ambient noise and are virtually impervious to the detuning effects of rain and ice that render non-loop antennas unusable. Adverse weather conditions and wind speeds of over 124 mph (200 km/h) are no problem for LFA Yagis. These antennas are made with 5/8 inch (16mm) parasitic elements complemented by a driven loop of 1/2 inch (13mm) and 3/8 inch (9.5mm) diameter tube. They include a ferrite choke with a low-loss type N female connector at a 50-ohm impedance. These antennas handle a maximum transmitter power of 5 kW. ov: InnovAntennas FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas represent exciting developments for the fascinating hobby of long distance (DX) reception of free, over-the-air broadcast FM radio. The OP-DES Yagi directional antennas are specially designed for better gain, great front-to-back and patterns with fewer side lobes, to dramatically improve your reception experience by helping your tuner or receiver achieve a new level of performance. For FM DX enthusiasts who own great FM Tuners and Receivers, pulling in new distant stations at full quieting is thrilling. Capturing a weak station while rejecting an on-channel stronger station can be especially gratifying. Hearing distant fringe and local stations at full fidelity without noise is the ultimate goal for FM audiophiles as well as FM DXers. Even HD Radio enthusiasts can increase their channel count with full sound quality and fewer dropouts. One of the distinctive design features of the InnovAntennas OP-DES Yagis is a low feedpoint impedance that allows either 50 ohm or 75 ohm coaxial cable to be connected directly to the driven element, eliminating the losses of a transformer balun. With several boom lengths available, for the FM enthusiast on a budget, for the casual listener with a treasured vintage receiver, and for the most discerning FM Tuner audiophile, best-ever reception is possible with an InnovAntenna FM Broadcast OP-DES Yagi. What is so special about InnovAntenna FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas? The acronym stands for “Opposing Phase Driven Element System” on which the ends of the driven element are angled backwards towards the reflector, parallel to the boom. Opposing phase in the ends of the driven element achieves an exceptionally clean directional pattern with much better side rejection than other designs. Plus, the OP-DES Yagi retains incredibly good front-to-back while optimizing gain over a wide frequency range, essential for 88 to 108 MHz coverage. The special OP-DES Yagi design achieves a low feed point impedance that allows direct connection of either 50 or 75 ohm coaxial cable, so the mounting complexity and signal loss of a transformer balun is eliminated. The use of an optional ferrite bead RF choke on the coax at the feedpoint terminals is highly recommended. These OP-DES FM Broadcast antennas actually handle up to 3 kW FM power with low SWR. ov: InnovAntennas 162 MHz AIS LFA Yagis InnovAntennas 162 MHz AIS LFA Yagis are vertically polarized Loop Fed Array (LFA) base station beam antennas designed specifically for 161.5 – 162.5 MHz range of the Marine Band, featuring simplified installation with integral rear-mount mast brackets. Three models are offered, each performance optimized with extensive computer modeling. High quality materials are used in manufacturing, ensuring durability and high reliability. InnovAntennas LFA Yagis inherently receive less ambient noise and are virtually impervious to the detuning effects of rain and ice that render non-loop antennas unusable. Adverse weather conditions and wind speeds of over 124 mph (200 km/h) are no problem for LFA Yagis. These antennas are made with 5/8 inch (16mm) parasitic elements complemented by a driven loop of 1/2 inch (13mm) and 3/8 inch (9.5mm) diameter tube. It also has fully insulated elements which will ensure continuous, high performance and ensures corrosion will not impact performance. Marine grade stainless steel is used throughout. They include a ferrite choke with a low-loss type N female connector at a 50-ohm impedance. These antennas handle a maximum transmitter power of 5 kW. AIS is the maritime Automatic Identification System, a radio-based transponder system that automatically tracks and identifies ships at sea by broadcasting their position, speed, course, and other data. Its purpose is to prevent collisions, assist in search and rescue operations, and help vessel traffic services (VTS) monitor traffic. InnovAntennas 162 MHz AIS LFA Yagis are specially designed for professional use at coastal radio stations, for use with AIS repeaters and for suppliers of AIS systems. Of course, they are also ideal for anyone who would like to enter the exciting and fascinating world of AIS reception or take their existing equipment to the next level. Due to their frequency coverage, InnovAntennas 162 MHZ AIS LFA Yagis are also ideal for long range directional reception of the National Weather Service (NWS) NOAA Weather Radio transmitters broadcasting on 162.400 through 162.550 MHz. The AIS system was developed, among other things, to improve safety in shipping, using the frequencies 161.975 and 162.025 MHz, corresponding to marine radio channels 87B and 88B. ov: InnovAntennas FM Broadcast 88-108 MHz OP-DES Yagi Antennas represent exciting developments for the fascinating hobby of long distance (DX) reception of free, over-the-air broadcast FM radio. The OP-DES Yagi directional antennas are specially designed for better gain, great front-to-back and patterns with fewer side lobes, to dramatically improve your reception experience by helping your tuner or receiver achieve a new level of performance. For FM DX enthusiasts who own great FM Tuners and Receivers, pulling in new distant stations at full quieting is thrilling. Capturing a weak station while rejecting an on-channel stronger station can be especially gratifying. Even HD Radio enthusiasts can increase their channel count with full sound quality and fewer dropouts. ov: InnovAntennas 162 MHz AIS LFA Yagis InnovAntennas 162 MHz AIS LFA Yagis are vertically polarized Loop Fed Array (LFA) base station beam antennas designed specifically for 161.5 – 162.5 MHz range of the Marine Band, featuring simplified installation with integral rear-mount mast brackets. Three models are offered, each performance optimized with extensive computer modeling. High quality materials are used in manufacturing, ensuring durability and high reliability. InnovAntennas LFA Yagis inherently receive less ambient noise and are virtually impervious to the detuning effects of rain and ice that render non-loop antennas unusable. Adverse weather conditions and wind speeds of over 124 mph (200 km/h) are no problem for LFA Yagis. These antennas are made with 5/8 inch (16mm) parasitic elements complemented by a driven loop of 1/2 inch (13mm) and 3/8 inch (9.5mm) diameter tube. It also has fully insulated elements which will ensure continuous, high performance and ensures corrosion will not impact performance. Marine grade stainless steel is used throughout. They include a ferrite choke with a low-loss type N female connector at a 50-ohm impedance. These antennas handle a maximum transmitter power of 5 kW. AIS is the maritime Automatic Identification System, a radio-based transponder system that automatically tracks and identifies ships at sea by broadcasting their position, speed, course, and other data. Its purpose is to prevent collisions, assist in search and rescue operations, and help vessel traffic services (VTS) monitor traffic. InnovAntennas 162 MHz AIS LFA Yagis are specially designed for professional use at coastal radio stations, for use with AIS repeaters and for suppliers of AIS systems. Of course, they are also ideal for anyone who would like to enter the exciting and fascinating world of AIS reception or take their existing equipment to the next level. Due to their frequency coverage, InnovAntennas 162 MHZ AIS LFA Yagis are also ideal for long range directional reception of the National Weather Service (NWS) NOAA Weather Radio transmitters broadcasting on 162.400 through 162.550 MHz. The AIS system was developed, among other things, to improve safety in shipping, using the frequencies 161.975 and 162.025 MHz, corresponding to marine radio channels 87B and 88B. ov: InnovAntenna 50MHz 9 Element LFA-KW Yagi InnovAntennas 50MHz 9 Element LFA-KW Yagi is a giant. This 49 ft. long boom, low noise Loop Fed Array model achieves the Lowest Ever Noise Figure! The G0KSC LFA Yagi is a major step forward in the development of the Yagi Antenna, providing a low noise "front-end" for any advanced 50 MHz radio to easily hear weak signals. This amazing 9 element LFA provides stunning performance across the 50.0 – 50.4 MHz weak signal section of the 6m band. This antenna is hard to beat with a direct-feed 50 Ohm feedpoint, no matching losses and suppression of unwanted noise. EME reviews on the Internet confirm that this 9 element LFA is an excellent antenna. It's very highly suppressed side lobes in both H and E planes make this model ideal for very noisy city locations. The LFA-KW Yagi antenna is made to survive the elements, with a 2.5-inch (63.5mm) square 0.126 in. (3.2mm) wall-thickness aluminum boom, with tapered elements consisting of 1/2-inch (12.7mm) element centers and 3/8-inch (9.525mm) outer sections. The antenna has fully insulated elements which ensures continuous, high performance for many years to come. The boom-to-mast bracket accommodates a 2-inch (50mm) mast and a Kevlar multi-point boom support system is provided with this horizontal only LFA Yagi antenna. A very capable and accurate tower-mounted rotator is required.Also used in production of InnovAntenna LFA Yagis:Marine Grade Stainless Steel FittingsOriginal Stauff Insulation clampsMill finished boom and elements for highest levels of accuracyInnovAntennas are constructed with the best quality materials in order to achieve the best possible mechanical construction, not the cheapest or most profitable. A digital caliper is used to measure the elements during production to ensure parts or within 0.2mm tolerance, ensuring each antenna works as well as the design software model predicts.A great deal of development time was put into InnovAntenna Yagis, but not only on the advanced electromagnetic design. Extensively modeling on the effect of insulators, booms and other parts ensures that every component of InnovAntenna Yagi has the least effect on performance and pattern degradation.For the 6-meter enthusiast who wants to beat the noise AND have maximum gain and front-to-back performance, THIS is the 50MHz Yagi for you.InnovAntennas 50MHz 9 Element LFA-KW Yagi

ov: InnovAntennas LFA-Q 4 Element 50 MHz Loop Quad Beams from G0KSC represents significant development of LFA Yagis with a substantial difference. The LFA-Q (Loop Fed Array Quad) uses top and bottom booms and through-boom LFA Yagi-style loops arranged vertically for every element. This very different, rugged design achieves better gain for a given length of boom than standard or LFA Yagi. Also, instead of using symmetrical square or triangular loops, the shape of the loops has been compressed into rectangular form, so the short side sections are exactly 180 degrees out of phase resulting in a cancellation effect, like a balanced line. InnovAntenna LFA-Q achieves great rejection to the sides and the rear of the antenna while retaining excellent gain, f/b and SWR bandwidth across the band. These are amazingly compact, high gain antennas constructed to withstand serious weather conditions!The 50MHz 4 Element LFA-Q is made with tapered elements one-half inch (12.7mm) center sections and 3/8 inch (9.525mm) outer sections. The antenna has fully insulated elements which will ensure continuous, high performance for years to come. The LFA-Q has a twin-boom system, 32mm square with 1.6mm wall thickness. Two boom-to-mast brackets are provided, one on each boom, formed from marine grade stainless steel. Both brackets include 2 square U-bolts for the boom and 2 round U-bolts for the supporting mast.InnovAntennas are constructed with the best quality materials in order that the best mechanical construction can be achieved, not the cheapest and most profitable! Even a digital caliper is used (with an accuracy of .01mm) to measure the elements during production to ensure they are within 0.2mm of spec, to ensure the antenna works as well as our software model predicts. Note: A great deal of development time has gone into our antennas, on mechanics as well as basic electromagnetic design, we are able to model the effect of insulators, booms and other objects to ensure the structure of our antennas have least effect on performance and pattern degradation.InnovAntennas LFA-Q 4 Element 50 MHz Loop Quad Beam Specs:Gain: 11.26dBi @ 50.150MHzF/B: 29.9dB @ 50.150MHzPeak Gain: 11.3dBiPeak F/B: 30.3dBPower Rating: 5kw+SWR: Below 1.3:1 from 50.00MHz to 50.400MHzStacking Distance: 5-8m (7m recommended)2 Stacked Gain @ 7m spacing: 14.35dBi (free space)2 Stacked F/B: 27.41dB2 Stacke

name: MFJ-58B, PVC CROSS LOOP KIT, 30/40M, FOR MFJ-933/935B/936B
desc: MFJ-58B, PVC CROSS LOOP KIT, 30/40M, FOR MFJ-933/935B/936B
ov:
The MFJ-58B PVC Cross Loop Antenna Kit, $49.95, includes a PVC Cross Mount that plugs into the top of the Loop Tuner for individually mounting three separate 10-gauge wires (13, 7, and 4 ft in length). A fourth, longer wire (28 ft in length) is also provided which can be attached to a bookshelf, curtain or other support. These four wire loops included in the MFJ-58B provide coverage from 60 - 10 Meters, or 5.330 - 29.700 MHz.
The 28-ft wire becomes an insulated 10-gauge flexible loop with low resistance lugs that operates on 60 and 40 meters. This loop is most efficient on 40 Meters, but can be tuned lower in frequency to 60 Meters with some efficiency loss depending on the loop shape, support, and environment. It can be clipped to a bookshelf, curtain or any other support that will allow the most convenient placement.
The 13-ft wire becomes an insulated 10-gauge flexible loop with low resistance lugs providing coverage on 30 and 20 Meters. The 13-ft wire works most efficiently on 20 Meters, but can be tuned to 30 Meters with some efficiency loss depending on the loop shape, support, and environment.
The 7-ft wire becomes an insulated 10-gauge flexible loop with low resistance lugs providing coverage on 20, 17, and 15 Meters. The 7-ft wire works most efficiently on 15 Meters, but can be tuned down to 20 Meters with some efficiency loss depending on the loop shape, support, and environment. 
The 4-ft wire becomes an insulated 10-gauge flexible loop with low resistance lugs providing coverage on 17, 12, and 10 Meters. The 4-ft wire works most efficiently on 10 Meters, but can be tuned down to 17 Meters with some efficiency loss depending on the loop shape, support, and environment.
The PVC Cross Mount consists of 5 sections of PVC tubing that connect together in seconds using a PVC Cross Connector (two different base tubes are provided which optimizes the PVC Cross Mount size for the wires used). Three loops can be attached to the PVC Cross Mount using the loop support bands provided on the PVC sections.
When assembled, the cross measures approximately 4½ feet across and has a maximum height of 4½ feet.. When disassembled and bundled together, the PVC sections only take up 2 inches x 2 inches x 26 inches of space.

name: MFJ-2990, 160-6M VERTICAL ANT., 43FT, 1500W, W/BALUN/MOUNT
desc: MFJ-2990, 160-6M VERTICAL ANT., 43FT, 1500W, W/BALUN/MOUNT
ov:
Get 160-6 Meters Coverage and 1500 Watt Operation with a single antenna!
This MFJ-2990 is a 43-foot self-supporting vertical antenna that covers 160 through 6 Meters with the use of an antenna tuner. 
It weighs just 20 lbs. and has a wind load of just 2 square feet. The antenna diameter is 2” OD at the bottom, 0.120" thick-walled tubing.
The top 6 foot section of this antenna consists of a 1/8” diameter solid stainless steel whip. This gives the MFJ-2990 the lowest wind-loading and is the least visually impacting 43-foot vertical antenna on the market! The entire length of this antenna radiates so you get great performance. 
It’s great for stealth operation for those in antenna restricted housing developments -- this very inconspicuous antenna looks like a tall tree or flagpole! You can put a flag on top, hide it behind trees, fences, buildings, bushes, or easily tilt-over in the day time.
MFJ-2990 is so lightweight, it’s easy to put it up at night and take it down in the morning before the neighbors even know what is going on! Ground mounts to completely hide the antenna base.
It includes a legal limit balun at the base and is base fed. The MFJ-2990 provides outstanding low radiation performance on 17 meters and below, and very good performance on the higher bands. 
It can be shortened for more effective low angle radiation on the higher bands if desired. Includes MFJ-1900 ($69.95 value) Ground Mount Base Kit.
The MFJ-2990 provides low SWR across the full 160-6 Meter frequency range with an antenna tuner.
Any external antenna tuner and many transceiver internal antenna tuners can easily match this antenna across the full frequency range.
When using good quality, low-loss coaxial cable, feedline losses due to SWR are
negligible (typically less than 1/2-dB).
MFJ-2990 is also built-to-last. It uses incredibly strong 6063 corrosion resistant aircraft strength aluminum tubing and stainless steel hardware.
And perhaps most important of all, It assembles easily in about an hour! Easy
installation makes it great for portable, temporary uses like field day, DXpeditions, etc.

name: MFJ-2982,31FT WIRE VERT. 80-6M, FEATHER LITE, 600W
desc: MFJ-2982,31FT WIRE VERT. 80-6M, FEATHER LITE, 600W
ov:
No trees, no problem! 31 self-supporting vertical sets up in minutes, collapses to only 3.8 ; perfect for RVs, vacations, field day, or as your grab-and-go kit. 
More than a simple "flagpole", this complete antenna system includes adjustable base-loading coil, Guanella balun, and counterpoise. 
 Rugged Vertical Element: stout 1 ¾" base supports twist-lock fiberglass sections -- telescope to 31in seconds. Despite its length, its so light one person can raise or lower it easily, even in wind. Special light-weight wire reduces weight distributed in top sections for improved rigidity and reduced sway. 
 Base Loading Network: Air-wound high efficiency loading coil is continuously tapped to provide full coverage 3.5 - 7 MHz. On 17 M, the inductor configures as a ⅝ - wave for added gain. On 20 M, adding inductance improves the load presented to your tuner. The base tuning unit is RF - isolated and can be attached to any supporting structure. 
 Portable Counterpoise: No guess work or ground rods needed, just connect four insulated 12 radial wires to the tuning unit and lay them on ground. 
 Guanella Balun: Lab rated with up to 30 dB common-mode suppression, the balun prevents feedline, radio, and you from becoming part of the antenna! 
 Easy Wire Handling: Detachable wire spooler makes handling/storing wire easy during setup/takedown. Attaches to antenna body for storage. 
 Add Wire: Use conductive eyebolt at antenna top to install wires for an inverted "L" or a "T" to enhance low frequency coverage. 
 Corrosion Resistant: All hardware is aluminum, stainless steel, or corrosion protected to ensure long life. 
 Low SWR: No tuner is needed for 80 / 75 / 60 / 40 / 17 Meters, because radiator length is fixed at 31. Operation on 30 / 20 / 15 / 12 / 10 / 6M requires an ATU. 
 PowerRating: MFJ-2982 components are safety-rated for 600 Watts PEP on SSB/CW.
